description: This is a Python script for running WebKit layout tests, managing test execution, configuration, and reporting.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Handles printing and logging of test results and configurations.

classes.name: BuildBotPrinter
classes.description: Outputs test results in a format suitable for Buildbot.

methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and executes the test run.

methods.name: parse_args

methods.name: _run_tests
